patch_description: Key changes from the current approach: (1) Add hull-expansion moves inside the hill climb — periodically try scaling all points by 1.01x and accept only if the true min/hull score improves, letting the optimizer shrink hull area when possible. (2) Use a sharper guidance blend (0.8·min + 0.2·mean of 3 smallest) for hill-climb guidance while final selection still uses the exact min/hull ratio. (3) Expand the seed set (more random restarts plus 6-fold lattice-like seeds), use 8-directional (diagonal) moves instead of axis-only for faster/better local search, and an adaptive step schedule with faster geometric decay (0.6x) to reach fine precision quickly. Together these widen global coverage and exploit hull-shrinking, targeting a higher true normalized minimum triangle area at modest runtime.
